camel_example: aliyun iot QueryDeviceProp --region cn-hangzhou --IotId Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --DeviceName light
description_en: Queries the tags of a specified device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定设备的标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-prop --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceProp

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the <props="intl"><ph>Instance Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device to be queried belongs.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备所隶属的产品ProductKey。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name to be queried.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device to be queried. The ID is issued by IoT Platform and uniquely identifies the device.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId uniquely identifies the device and corresponds to the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

Props.description_en: The list of device tags returned if the call succeeds. The value is a JSON string
Props.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的设备标签信息列表，JSON String格式

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed

表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
